titles.text: A randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2 study of Vasclarin (VSC-9) in adults with stage 1 or 2 hypertension

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: IN01
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Aged 18 to 75 years when consent is signed

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: IN02
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Mean seated systolic blood pressure 140 to 179 mmHg at screening

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: IN03
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants of childbearing potential use highly effective contraception and have a negative pregnancy test

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: EX03
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Serum potassium above 5.5 mmol/L at screening

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: EX04
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Use of a potassium-sparing diuretic or potassium supplement within 4 weeks before screening

notes.text: a: three seated readings 2 minutes apart after 5 minutes’ rest; the mean of the second and third is recorded.

activities.label: Dispense trial intervention; accountability and adherence

notes.text: b: collected from the signing of informed consent until the Week 14 follow-up visit.
